scope_statement: Patch-shaped product audit command atom: add deterministic product audit CLI sections derived from existing product workflow artifact validation.

commands: JSON/JSONL validation for durable workflow artifacts
concrete credential-pattern privacy scan over durable effort artifacts

privacy_note: No raw prompts, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, or customer data stored.
implementation_summary: Added runProductAudit command with --effort-root and --json flags. Reuses lintEffortFolder internally and classifies findings into prd, adr, tdd, traceability, and reports sections via classifyAuditSection and buildAuditResult. Human output includes per-section status summary. Updated usage text. Added 9 tests covering durable fixture pass, JSON section structure, parse_error surfacing in PRD/ADR/TDD sections, lint behavior preservation, usage/help/telemetry parity.
